title: 125 Elmer Ave, home for sale, Toronto
description:
Welcome to 125 Elmer Avenue, a detached home on a large corner lot in the Beach neighbourhood of Toronto, and represented by DeClute Real Estate Brokerage.

Renovated in 2013, this home features new windows and doors, and oak strip hardwood flooring is found throughout the main level. 

The living room is centred around a wood burning fireplace, and there is walk-out access to a new cedar front porch overlooking the front yard.

The upgraded kitchen features a breakfast bar, new counter top with under mount sink, modern cabinetry, and new stainless steel appliances. 

Open to the kitchen, the dining room is an ideal setting for both formal and informal gatherings. Sliding doors provide access to the backyard patio area, perfect for summertime barbecuing and entertaining. 

The detached 2-car garage is accessible from the backyard, and there is parking for four cars in total.

The upper level is fully carpeted for comfort and coziness, and features three spacious bedrooms and a full 4-pc washroom.

Additional family living space is offered in the finished basement, as well as a 3-pc washroom and laundry room.

With its quiet, sought-after prime location in the Williamson Road School District, this home offers plenty of room for growing families.

For more information, or to arrange a private viewing of this home, please contact DeClute Real Estate Brokerage, at 416-686-9618.
author: Open House 24
